name: Camberley Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at St Paul's Church. Open Tue and Fri for distribution. Referral required via local agencies and schools.

description: Surrey Heath Borough Council manages sites at Yorktown
image: and Heatherside. Plots from £35/year. Waiting lists available for most sites. Includes water access and tool sheds.

name: Camberley Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden at Old Dean providing therapeutic gardening for mental health wellbeing. Grows seasonal vegetables with harvest shared among volunteers. Wellbeing sessions Wednesdays.
